```{r packages}
#shared colors (Okabe-Ito, colorblind-friendly) and labels
transect_cols   <- c("Reference" = "#009E73", "Disturbed" = "#D55E00")
site_labels     <- c(
  "Babbitt" = "Babbitt PJ", "BarTBar" = "Bar T Bar", "Canyonlands" = "CRC",

    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

#save ggplot figs as PNG and PDF
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = width_double, height = 100) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, units = "mm", dpi = 600)
  pdf_dev <- if (capabilities("cairo")) cairo_pdf else "pdf"  # cairo renders the dagger symbol
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".pdf")), plot,
         width = width, height = height, units = "mm", device = pdf_dev)
}

#save base-graphics figs (corrplot, DHARMa) as PNG
save_base_fig <- function(name, plot_expr, width = width_double, height = 110) {
  png(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".png")),
      width = width, height = height, units = "mm", res = 600)
  on.exit(dev.off())
  plot_expr
}
```

# 2. Data import

Empty root-scoring cells mean a structure was not observed, and blank biocrust
cells (two Flying M Reference points) mean no biocrust, so both are set to 0.

```{r import}
mip_all <- read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "Dryland_Mycorrhizal_Inoculum_Potential.xlsx")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(no_fungus:am_RLC, ~ replace_na(as.numeric(.x), 0)),
    biocrust_cover = replace_na(biocrust_cover, 0),  
    site        = factor(site),
    transect    = factor(ifelse(transect == "R", "Reference", "Disturbed"),
                         levels = c("Reference", "Disturbed")),
    transect_ID = interaction(site, transect, drop = TRUE),
    colonized   = round(am_RLC),          #intersections colonized (of 100)
    uncolonized = 100 - colonized
  )

#host-specific datasets
bogr <- filter(mip_all, bioassay_host == "Bouteloua gracilis")
corn <- filter(mip_all, bioassay_host == "Zea mays")

#combo dataset for the two-host model. Each B. gracilis and Z. mays pot was
#filled from the same field sample, so pairs are matched by site, transect, and
#position along the transect (m_mark).
both_hosts <- mip_all %>%
  mutate(
    bioassay_host = factor(bioassay_host,
                           levels = c("Bouteloua gracilis", "Zea mays")),
    soil_ID = interaction(site, transect, m_mark, drop = TRUE)
  )
```

# 3. Transect effects: two-way ANOVAs and within-site contrasts (Fig 1, Table S2)

Each site contributes one pre-specified Reference vs Disturbed contrast, following
a significant site x transect interaction, so contrasts are not adjusted for
multiple comparisons. Each contrast is reported with its 95% CI and Cohen's d
(contrast / ANOVA residual SD). As a robustness check, contrasts are also
recalculated with heteroscedasticity-consistent (HC3) standard errors.

```{r anova-function}
sig_symbol <- function(p) {
  case_when(
    p < 0.001 ~ "***",
    p < 0.01  ~ "**",
    p < 0.05  ~ "*",
    p < 0.10  ~ "\u2020",   #dagger = marginally significant
    TRUE      ~ "ns"
  )
}

run_host_anova <- function(dat) {
  fit <- aov(am_RLC ~ transect * site, data = dat)

  #assumption checks
  shapiro <- shapiro.test(residuals(fit))
  levene  <- leveneTest(am_RLC ~ interaction(site, transect), data = dat)

  eta <- eta_squared(fit, partial = TRUE, ci = 0.95)

  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ transect | site)

  #reference - disturbed within each site, with 95% CIs (no adjustment)
  contrasts <- pairs(emm, adjust = "none") %>%
    summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  #Cohen's d = contrast / residual SD
  d_vals <- eff_size(emm, sigma = sigma(fit), edf = df.residual(fit)) %>%
    summary() %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(site, cohens_d = effect.size, d_lower = lower.CL, d_upper = upper.CL)

  #robustness check: HC3 (heteroscedasticity-consistent) standard errors
  #(refit as lm: emmeans can't take a custom vcov for an aov object)
  fit_lm <- lm(am_RLC ~ transect * site, data = dat)
  robust <- emmeans(fit_lm, ~ transect | site,
                    vcov. = car::hccm(fit_lm, type = "hc3")) %>%
    pairs(adjust = "none") %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(site, SE_HC3 = SE, p_HC3 = p.value)

  contrasts <- contrasts %>%
    left_join(d_vals, by = "site") %>%
    left_join(robust, by = "site")

  list(fit = fit, anova = summary(fit), shapiro = shapiro, levene = levene,
       eta = eta, contrasts = contrasts)
}

bogr_aov <- run_host_anova(bogr)
corn_aov <- run_host_anova(corn)
```

```{r anova-results, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 10}

plot(corn_aov$fit, main = "Z. mays")
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

#B. gracilis
bogr_aov$anova
bogr_aov$eta
bogr_aov$shapiro
bogr_aov$levene
bogr_aov$contrasts

#Z. mays
corn_aov$anova
corn_aov$eta
corn_aov$shapiro
corn_aov$levene
corn_aov$contrasts

#Table S2 (contrast portion)

  bogr_aov$contrasts %>% mutate(host = "B. gracilis"),
  corn_aov$contrasts %>% mutate(host = "Z. mays")
) %>%
```

## Fig 1

```{r figure-1, fig.height = 7.5}
host_boxplot <- function(dat, contrasts, host_label) {
  labels <- contrasts %>%
    mutate(sig = sig_symbol(p.value),
           y   = max(dat$am_RLC) * 1.1)   #same height for every site in this host's row

  ggplot(dat, aes(transect, am_RLC, fill = transect)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 1, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = labels, aes(x = 1.5, y = y, label = sig),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 4) +
    facet_grid(~ site, labeller = labeller(site = site_labels)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = transect_cols, name = "Transect") +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.1))) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "AM colonization (%)", title = host_label) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(size = 11))
}

fig1a <- host_boxplot(bogr, bogr_aov$contrasts, expression(italic("B. gracilis")))
fig1b <- host_boxplot(corn, corn_aov$contrasts, expression(italic("Z. mays")))

#paired-sample regression between hosts
paired <- inner_join(
  bogr %>% select(site, transect, m_mark, bogr = am_RLC),
  corn %>% select(site, transect, m_mark, corn = am_RLC),
  by = c("site", "transect", "m_mark")
)

host_lm <- lm(corn ~ bogr, data = paired)
summary(host_lm)

fig1c <- ggplot(paired, aes(bogr, corn)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x, color = "black",
              fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.7) +
  geom_point(aes(color = transect), size = 1.6, alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_poly_eq(
    aes(label = paste(after_stat(eq.label), after_stat(rr.label),
                      after_stat(p.value.label), sep = "*\"; \"*")),
    formula = y ~ x, parse = TRUE, size = 3.2, small.p = TRUE,
    label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = 0.97
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.15))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = transect_cols, guide = "none") +
```

# 4. Plant community composition: NMDS and PERMANOVA (Fig 2)

```{r nmds-setup}
comm_cols <- c(
  "nat_shrub_cover", "nonnat_shrub_cover", "nat_grass_cover",
  "nonnat_grass_cover", "nat_forb_cover", "nonnat_forb_cover",
  "biocrust_cover", "bare_cover"
)

covar_labels <- c(
  nat_shrub_cover = "Native shrub", nonnat_shrub_cover = "Non-native shrub",
  nat_grass_cover = "Native grass", nonnat_grass_cover = "Non-native grass",
  nat_forb_cover  = "Native forb",  nonnat_forb_cover  = "Non-native forb",
  biocrust_cover  = "Biocrust",     bare_cover         = "Bare ground"
)

comm <- as.matrix(bogr[, comm_cols])
veg_dist <- vegdist(comm, method = "bray")
```

```{r permanova}
#global PERMANOVA and homogeneity of dispersion
permanova_all <- adonis2(veg_dist ~ transect * site, data = bogr,
                         permutations = 999, by = "terms")
permanova_all
anova(betadisper(veg_dist, bogr$transect))
anova(betadisper(veg_dist, bogr$site))
```

```{r figure-2, fig.height = 8}
#(a) global NMDS with cover vectors
nmds_all <- metaMDS(comm, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 200,
                    autotransform = TRUE, trace = FALSE)

scores_all <- as.data.frame(scores(nmds_all, display = "sites")) %>%
  bind_cols(bogr %>% select(site, transect))

vec_fit <- envfit(nmds_all, bogr[, comm_cols], permutations = 999)
vec_fit

vec_df <- as.data.frame(scores(vec_fit, display = "vectors")) %>%
  rownames_to_column("variable") %>%
  mutate(label = covar_labels[variable],
         across(c(NMDS1, NMDS2), ~ .x * ordiArrowMul(vec_fit)))

fig2a <- ggplot(scores_all, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = transect)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = transect), type = "norm", level = 0.95,
               geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +   #95% normal data ellipses
  geom_point(size = 1.8, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_segment(data = vec_df, aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = NMDS1, yend = NMDS2),
               inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = 0.4,
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"))) +
  geom_text_repel(data = vec_df, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, label = label),
                  inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3, min.segment.length = Inf) +
  scale_color_manual(values = transect_cols, name = "Transect") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = transect_cols, guide = "none") +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(subtitle = paste0("Bray-Curtis; stress = ", round(nmds_all$stress, 3))) +
  theme_pub

#(b) independent NMDS and PERMANOVA within each site
site_nmds <- bogr %>%
  split(.$site) %>%
  imap(function(d, site_name) {
    m <- as.matrix(d[, comm_cols])
    set.seed(123)
    nm <- metaMDS(m, distance = "bray", k = 2, trymax = 200,
                  autotransform = TRUE, trace = FALSE)
    ad <- adonis2(vegdist(m, method = "bray") ~ transect, data = d,
                  permutations = 999)
    list(
      scores = as.data.frame(scores(nm, display = "sites")) %>%
        mutate(site = site_name, transect = d$transect),
      stats = tibble(site = site_name, stress = nm$stress,
                     R2 = ad$R2[1], p_perm = ad$`Pr(>F)`[1])
    )
  })

site_scores <- map_dfr(site_nmds, "scores")
site_stats  <- map_dfr(site_nmds, "stats") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("stress = ", round(stress, 3),
                        "\nPERMANOVA p = ", signif(p_perm, 2)))
site_stats

fig2b <- ggplot(site_scores, aes(NMDS1, NMDS2, color = transect)) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(fill = transect), type = "norm", level = 0.95,
               geom = "polygon", alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +   #95% normal data ellipses
  geom_point(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_text(data = site_stats, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.15, size = 2.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ site, nrow = 2, labeller = labeller(site = site_labels)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = transect_cols, guide = "none") +  #legend comes from (a)
  scale_fill_manual(values = transect_cols, guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.25)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.25)) +
  theme_pub +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 8))

fig2 <- fig2a / fig2b +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1.1, 1), guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

fig2
save_fig(fig2, "Figure2", height = 230)
```

# 5. Cover regressions and correlations (Fig 3, Fig S4)

```{r figure-3, fig.height = 7}
fmt_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001", sprintf("p = %.3f", p))

cover_plot <- function(xvar, xlab) {
  stats <- bogr %>%
    group_by(site) %>%
    group_modify(~ {
      m <- lm(reformulate(xvar, "am_RLC"), data = .x)
      tibble(intercept = coef(m)[1], slope = coef(m)[2],
             r2 = summary(m)$r.squared,
             p  = coef(summary(m))[2, "Pr(>|t|)"])
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      sig = ifelse(p < 0.05, "sig", "ns"),
      label = sprintf("y = %.1f %s %.2fx\nR\u00b2 = %.2f, %s",
                      intercept, ifelse(slope < 0, "\u2212", "+"), abs(slope),
                      r2, fmt_p(p))
    )
  print(stats)

  bogr %>%
    left_join(select(stats, site, sig), by = "site") %>%
    ggplot(aes(.data[[xvar]], am_RLC)) +
    geom_smooth(aes(linetype = sig), method = "lm", formula = y ~ x,
                color = "black", fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.35,
                linewidth = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_point(aes(color = transect), size = 1.4, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = stats, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, hjust = -0.04, vjust = 1.2, size = 2.2,
              lineheight = 0.95) +
    facet_grid(~ site, labeller = labeller(site = site_labels)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = transect_cols, name = "Transect") +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(sig = "solid", ns = "22")) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 50, 100)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.35))) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = expression(italic("B. gracilis") * " colonization (%)")) +
    theme_pub +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.spacing.x = unit(4, "mm"))
}

fig3a <- cover_plot("nat_grass_cover", "Native grass cover (%)")
fig3b <- cover_plot("bare_cover", "Bare ground cover (%)")

fig3 <- fig3a / fig3b +
  plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "a", tag_prefix = "(", tag_suffix = ")") &
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

fig3
save_fig(fig3, "Figure3", height = 185)
```

# 6. Beta-binomial GLMM (main model; Fig S5)

```{r glmm}
bogr <- bogr %>%
  mutate(grass_c = as.numeric(scale(nat_grass_cover, scale = FALSE)),
         bare_c  = as.numeric(scale(bare_cover,      scale = FALSE)))

m_bb <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(colonized, uncolonized) ~ grass_c + bare_c + (1 | site/transect),
  family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
  data = bogr
)

summary(m_bb)
car::Anova(m_bb, type = 2)                        #wald chi-square tests
#odds ratios per 10% increase in cover
or_per10 <- function(model) {
  model_parameters(model, effects = "fixed", ci = 0.95) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    filter(Parameter %in% c("grass_c", "bare_c")) %>%
    mutate(across(c(Coefficient, CI_low, CI_high), ~ exp(10 * .x))) %>%
    select(Parameter, OR_per10 = Coefficient, CI_low, CI_high, p)
}
or_per10(m_bb)
r2_nakagawa(m_bb)                                 #marginal / conditional R2
sigma(m_bb)                                       #beta-binomial dispersion
```

```{r glmm-collinearity}
cor(bogr$nat_grass_cover, bogr$bare_cover)
check_collinearity(m_bb)                          #VIF
```

```{r glmm-predictions}
#predicted colonization across observed range of each predictor
grass_pred <- ggpredict(m_bb, terms = "grass_c")
bare_pred  <- ggpredict(m_bb, terms = "bare_c")
round(range(grass_pred$predicted) * 100, 1)
round(range(bare_pred$predicted)  * 100, 1)
```

```{r glmm-diagnostics, fig.height = 5}
res_bb <- simulateResiduals(m_bb, n = 1000)

testUniformity(res_bb, plot = FALSE)
testDispersion(res_bb, plot = FALSE)
testOutliers(res_bb, plot = FALSE)
check_overdispersion(m_bb)

plot(res_bb)
save_base_fig("FigureS5", plot(res_bb))
```

# 7. AR(1) sensitivity model for within-transect autocorrelation (Fig S2)

```{r ar1}
bogr <- bogr %>%
  mutate(position_f = factor(m_mark, levels = sort(unique(m_mark))))

m_bb_ar1 <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(colonized, uncolonized) ~ grass_c + bare_c +
    (1 | site/transect) + ar1(position_f + 0 | transect_ID),
  family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
  data = bogr
)

summary(m_bb_ar1)
```

```{r figure-S2, fig.height = 3.5}
aic_tab <- AIC(m_bb, m_bb_ar1)

coef_compare <- bind_rows(
  or_per10(m_bb)     %>% mutate(model = "Original model"),
  or_per10(m_bb_ar1) %>% mutate(model = "AR(1) model")
) %>%
  mutate(
    Parameter = dplyr::recode(Parameter,             
                              grass_c = "Native grass cover",
                              bare_c  = "Bare ground cover"),
    model = factor(model, levels = c("Original model", "AR(1) model"))
  )

figS2 <- ggplot(coef_compare, aes(OR_per10, Parameter, color = model)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "22", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = CI_low, xmax = CI_high),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), size = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Original model" = "black",
                                "AR(1) model" = "#0072B2"), name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Odds ratio per 10% increase in cover (95% CI)", y = NULL,
       subtitle = sprintf("AIC: original = %.1f; AR(1) = %.1f",
                          aic_tab["m_bb", "AIC"], aic_tab["m_bb_ar1", "AIC"])) +
  theme_pub

figS2
save_fig(figS2, "FigureS2", height = 75)
```

# 8. Combined-host GLMM (Fig S3)

```{r combined-model}
both_hosts <- both_hosts %>%
  mutate(grass_c = as.numeric(scale(nat_grass_cover, scale = FALSE)),
         bare_c  = as.numeric(scale(bare_cover,      scale = FALSE)))

m_hosts <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(colonized, uncolonized) ~ bioassay_host + grass_c + bare_c +
    (1 | site/transect) + (1 | soil_ID),
  family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
  data = both_hosts
)

m_hosts_int <- glmmTMB(
  cbind(colonized, uncolonized) ~ bioassay_host * (grass_c + bare_c) +
    (1 | site/transect) + (1 | soil_ID),
  family = betabinomial(link = "logit"),
  data = both_hosts
)

summary(m_hosts)
model_parameters(m_hosts, exponentiate = TRUE, ci = 0.95)   #host odds ratio 
or_per10(m_hosts)                                           #cover odds ratios per 10% 
anova(m_hosts, m_hosts_int)    #do cover effects differ by host?
```

```{r figure-S3, fig.height = 5}
res_hosts <- simulateResiduals(m_hosts, n = 1000)

testUniformity(res_hosts, plot = FALSE)
testDispersion(res_hosts, plot = FALSE)
testOutliers(res_hosts, plot = FALSE)

plot(res_hosts)
save_base_fig("FigureS3", plot(res_hosts))
```
